svg.text: Where one decode step goes (TP4, DSpark k=6, 1 user, torch profiler)
From the loop's profile notes (results.tsv, commits 37ff927 and 89c7989). Shares are of GPU time per step.
Before: vLLM custom all-reduce over PCIe P2P
After: NCCL all-reduce + split-K sparse-MLA decode
• All-reduce: about 100 µs per call (NCCL RING_LL) instead of 186 µs.
• Attention decode kernel: 56 → 39.5 µs (split-K uses more SMs; the old path used about 10% of them).
• Step period about 29 ms for 7 tokens. MoE (Marlin MXFP4) and FP8 GEMM (Marlin) are near their memory limit per call.
• Own Triton push all-reduce: 44 µs per call, step 27.8 ms, but single-user decode not better in 2 runs. • Skinny FP8 GEMM: equal to or slower than Marlin.
Next: all-reduce through pinned host memory; local argmax instead of logits all-gather (about 1.2 ms per step); fuse small kernels.
